content: The Earth Elemetal made a great pickaxe that can quickly create your tunnels, but what about the dirt and sand?
This Shovel you just created can take care of that, but not as you first expected.
Sure it does a 3x3 area as well, but only rows, not in any other direction. Maybe you didn't use enough Earth Elemetal?
Anyway, the Shovel also comes with the on/off switch to turn it into single block mode, in case you want to be more precise with your digging.
